q1_what_did_you_play: I played Rapid Fire first, using the 3 Spark bank to make it cost 0, then played Kaboom! for its printed cost of 1. This deals 16 damage from Rapid Fire and 7 damage from Kaboom!, for 23 total damage to Nibbit, leaving it at 20 HP. I did not play Slow Burn or Duck and Cover.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Rapid Fire followed by Duck and Cover, or Duck and Cover followed by Rapid Fire, for 16 damage and 5 Block. I also considered Slow Burn followed by Duck and Cover for 10 Block and no damage, but that gave up too much immediate damage against a 43 HP enemy that I could not kill this turn.
q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up all Block. Nibbit’s telegraphed 12 damage will reduce my HP from 42 to 30. It also gave up the Burst-related value from Slow Burn and the extra survivability from Duck and Cover. In exchange, it maximized immediate damage by using the Spark discount on the higher-printed-cost attack and then spending the remaining energy on the other attack.
q4_different_intent: Yes. If Nibbit’s intent had been a much larger attack, especially one that could threaten my remaining 42 HP more seriously, I would have shifted toward a Block line such as Slow Burn plus Duck and Cover, or Rapid Fire plus Duck and Cover. If the intent had been Defend or a non-damaging Skill, the damage-maximizing line would have remained at least as attractive.
